sql: SELECT year, total_population, public_coverage, no_health_insurance FROM census.acs_health_insurance WHERE state='53' AND (county IS NULL OR county='' OR county='000') AND year IN (2023,2024) ORDER BY year, total_population DESC FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY
